plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: History (BS). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Must make a grade of C or better.
[grid1 fn2] See departmental advisor for approved list
[grid1 fn3] At least 12 hours at the 300- and 400-level. At least 3 hours of pre-modern history and at least 3 hours each from three of the five lists (United States; Europe; Latin America and Caribbean; Africa, Asia and the Middle East; Thematic). Maximum 3 hours of HIST 484 may be used. Maximum 3 hours of 200- level course may be used.
[grid1 fn4] Select any 100-499 course not used elsewhere. (except ASCC 100-499) Up 12 hours of HIST 300-499 may be used for this requirement; up to 6 hours of HIST 100-299 may be used for this requirement. Only 14 hours of KINE 199 ; AERS 100-499; MLSC 100-499; NVSC 100-499; SOMS 100-499 may be used towards general electives.
[grid1 fn5] Writing-intensive course.
